She is best known for her role in the reinstatement of her husband, Tribhuvanamalla, as the ruler of the Chalukya empire. After his defeat in battle, he was taken as a prisoner to the eastern Chalukya kingdom. Joshini managed to secure his release by winning the heart of the enemy king, Jatavarman, and persuading him to free her husband.
